name: Rhys Llewellyn
bio:
Rhys's journey into motorsport began in his youth, assisting his father in restoring classic cars. This instilled in him a deep appreciation for aesthetics and meticulous craftsmanship. After an apprenticeship at a local body shop, he specialized in custom paintwork, quickly gaining a reputation for his exceptional eye for color and flawless finishes. He eventually made the leap to motorsport, drawn by the unique challenges and demands of applying his skills to high-performance vehicles.

At Manthey Racing, Rhys is responsible for ensuring every car leaves the paint shop looking its absolute best. He meticulously oversees every stage of the painting process, from surface preparation to the final clear coat. His unwavering commitment to perfection and calm demeanor under pressure make him an invaluable asset to the team. He believes the car's appearance is a direct reflection of the team's dedication to excellence, and he strives to make every car a masterpiece.

physical.description: Rhys is of average height with a sturdy build, often seen with a focused expression.

quirks: Always polishes his spectacles before starting a new project.
Has a collection of vintage car magazines he brings to the shop.
Insists on listening to classical music while working.
